summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Gogo Nushi, an Albanian political figure. It gives his birth and death dates (1913 to 1970) and states that he held a number of positions in Albania during its socialist period. The note provides no further biographical detail.
one_line: Gogo Nushi (1913–1970) was an Albanian political figure who held several posts during Albania's socialist period.
key_facts: Gogo Nushi was born on February 15, 1913.
Gogo Nushi was an Albanian political figure.
Gogo Nushi served in a number of positions in Albania.
Gogo Nushi's positions were held during Albania's socialist period.
